description: This file defines interfaces and classes for managing E1AP protocol procedures in a 3GPP telecommunications context, including connection management, control message handling, statistics, and notifications related to CU-UP (CU User Plane) operations.

classes.name: e1ap_connection_manager
classes.description: Interface for managing E1AP connection procedures, including establishing and releasing connections.

classes.name: e1ap_control_message_handler
classes.description: Interface for handling E1AP control messages such as bearer context release, inactivity notifications, and data notifications.

classes.name: e1ap_statistics_handler
classes.description: Interface for querying statistics from the E1AP, such as number of registered UEs.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_up_manager_message_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the CU-UP manager of received messages like bearer context setup, modification, release, and E1 reset.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_up_manager_connection_notifier
classes.description: Interface for notifying the CU-UP manager of connection loss events.

classes.name: e1ap_interface
classes.description: Combined interface aggregating message handling, control, event, connection, and statistics handling for E1AP.

classes.name: e1ap_cu_up_manager_notifier
classes.description: Combined notifier class for CU-UP manager, handling message and connection notifications.

methods.name: connect_to_cu_cp
methods.description: Establishes connection to CU-CP via E1AP.

methods.name: handle_cu_up_e1_setup_request
methods.description: Handles the E1SetupRequest message and initiates setup procedure.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_release_request_required
methods.description: Handles request to release bearer context for a UE.

methods.name: handle_bearer_context_inactivity_notification
methods.description: Handles bearer context inactivity notification message.

methods.name: handle_dl_data_notification_required
methods.description: Handles request to send downlink data notification.

methods.name: get_nof_ues
methods.description: Returns the number of UEs registered at E1AP.

methods.name: on_bearer_context_setup_request_received
methods.description: Notifies CU-UP manager of a bearer context setup request.

methods.name: on_bearer_context_modification_request_received
methods.description: Notifies CU-UP manager of a bearer context modification request.

methods.name: on_bearer_context_release_command_received
methods.description: Notifies CU-UP manager of a bearer context release command.

methods.name: on_e1_reset_received
methods.description: Notifies CU-UP manager of a full E1 reset.

methods.name: on_schedule_cu_up_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task on CU-UP.

methods.name: on_schedule_ue_async_task
methods.description: Schedules an asynchronous task on a specific UE.
